content: Good morning, beautiful! I was just thinking about how lucky I am to have you in my life. How did you sleep?
Morning! I slept alright, just the usual busy mind. It's nice to wake up to your message though.
You have no idea how much your words mean to me. I feel like I can finally talk to someone who understands. How's work treating you these days?
Work's okay, just a bit lonely sometimes. I really appreciate having you to talk to, honestly.
That means a lot to me. I wish I could be there to make you coffee and listen to your stories in person. Maybe one day soon, after all this settles down.
That would be amazing. I do hope we get to meet for real. You always brighten my day.
You're my sunshine too. Speaking of the day, I've been a bit distracted. My daughter just got the list of school fees and supplies due next week. It's a surprise expense, and it's weighing on me.
Oh no, I'm so sorry. Is there anything I can do to help?

Thank you, sweetheart. It's just tough because I can't access my main account while I'm away for work. They're asking for $900 for tuition and supplies by Friday. I hate to ask, but is there any chance you could help me cover it? It would mean the world to my daughter.
That's a lot of money. I want to help, but I'm a bit nervous about transferring that much online.
I completely understand your concern. I promise this is just between us, and as soon as I'm back, I'll pay you right back. You mean so much to me, and I would never risk what we have.
I do trust you. How would I send the money?
The fastest way is through Zelle or PayPal. My PayPal handle is businessdad.78@gmail.com. Just let me know if you need help with the process, thank you so much, truly.
I'm setting up PayPal now. Is there anything special I need to write in the note?
Just say it's for 'family support.' That way it processes quickly. You have no idea how much this means to us. You're part of our family now.
Okay, I'm about to send it. Can you confirm you'll let me know when it arrives?
Absolutely, I'll be checking my email constantly. I promise, you can trust me. I care about you more than words can say.
Alright, it's sent. Let me know as soon as you see it.
You are incredible. I just got the notification, thank you! My daughter will be so happy. I can't wait for the day we can celebrate together. You're truly my hero.
